## India: Regulatory & Enforcement Updates

The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has officially opened applications for the chairperson and members of the Data Protection Board of India, signaling a critical step towards operationalizing the DPDPA's enforcement mechanisms. This move paves the way for the Board to begin its adjudication and penalty functions. ([Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxOaVR4MW9NWUdLSkM5eEVJNFlNeWJBVVRRNzhaU3d0VGdlMlh0V0ExNlNrU2lUdllVMGpYdFFGQ3lIZ1kyOEFIbXNlWks2cHFSX2lTRlB4d1gxY1NDbU1FV3NfRFVYYTB2V29haVpVTEYyWmtDeHFHLURaYnZyaUtlTlptazN3dTc0cVVIajJoenhPTEVCRTFLZjlfVW94OU1YT0U5RWV2VjdZN3JULUlqd1ViM2RBQm02Ti1GTVpWc1hPNnUwZk5XdA?oc=5))

In a significant development, the Supreme Court has directed MeitY to investigate a Public Interest Litigation (PIL) concerning the recovery or destruction of Indian citizens' personal data stolen and stored on foreign servers. This underscores the judiciary's increasing focus on data sovereignty and protection, even when data resides outside India's borders. ([Source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5))

MeitY also recognized IDfy as the winner of its NeGD DPDP Innovation Challenge, highlighting government efforts to foster technological solutions aligned with privacy enforcement. This initiative encourages the development of tools that can aid DPDPA compliance and data protection. ([Source](https://news.google.?oc=5))

## India: DPDPA Compliance & Implementation

With the DPDP Rules 2025 now published, Indian enterprises are actively navigating critical compliance deadlines for 2026-27, emphasizing the urgent need to secure data at its source. Businesses are focusing on establishing robust data governance frameworks to meet these regulatory requirements.
